description: A durable, queryable per-file status ledger for batch document intake: a local JSONL store (append-only on disk, latest-write-per-key on read) tracking each file through discovered/processing/extracted/failed/reviewed, keyed by a content hash (e.g. an S3 etag). Registers a DocumentIntakeStatusLedger resource other asset/sensor code reads and writes, plus a summary asset with per-status counts and an optional stuck-processing check. Composes with sensors/s3_monitor without modifying it.

outputs.description: summary() output: {counts: {discovered, processing, extracted, failed, reviewed}, total, recent_failed}. Metadata on the materialization carries count_<status>, total_count, recent_failed.

ledger_name.label: Ledger Name
ledger_name.description: Used to derive the default ledger_path ('./{ledger_name}.jsonl') and the default summary asset name ('{ledger_name}_intake_summary').

ledger_path.label: Ledger Path
ledger_path.description: Path to the local JSONL ledger file. Default: './{ledger_name}.jsonl'. Created (with parent directories) on first write.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key the ledger is registered under -- reference it from your own asset/sensor code via required_resource_keys.

summary_asset_name.label: Summary Asset Name
summary_asset_name.description: Dagster asset name for the summary asset. Default: '{ledger_name}_intake_summary'.

recent_failed_cap.label: Recent Failed Cap
recent_failed_cap.description: Max number of most-recent failed entries surfaced by the summary asset's metadata.

stuck_after_minutes.label: Stuck After Minutes
stuck_after_minutes.description: When set, the summary asset also emits an asset check that fails when any file has been in 'processing' longer than this many minutes. Unset (default): no check.

stuck_severity.label: Stuck Severity
stuck_severity.description: Asset check severity when files are stuck: 'WARN' or 'ERROR'. Only used when stuck_after_minutes is set.

cron_schedule.label: Cron Schedule
cron_schedule.description: Optional cron expression; when set, a schedule re-materializes the summary asset on this cadence (e.g. '*/5 * * * *').

owners.description: Asset owners -- team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

name: document_intake_status_ledger
